title: She Makes $1k/Day Sending Letters
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: The host opens by saying Hannah makes about $30,000 a month in profit and had almost no startup costs. Hannah later says profit is about $25,000; the transcript does not establish startup costs. Some month-to-month subscriber figures are also corrected inconsistently.

stated_problem.quote: Oh, I wish this was near me or I wish that I had this in my community.
stated_problem.speaker: Hannah

idea.name: The Tiny Post
idea.one_liner: A monthly mailed bundle of original art, recipes, stickers, and a personal letter for subscribers who want a tangible creative connection.
idea.customer: People who enjoy snail mail, art, and supporting small artists.
idea.offer: A themed, lightweight envelope of original paper goods and a personal letter.
idea.revenue_model: Monthly subscription, with possible sales of archive letters and higher-priced bundles.

key_quotes.quote: And so I started the Tiny Post, which was a snail mail club.
And I just put together my art and a recipe that I was working on with my jams, a few stickers, and I put it all in a 1 oz envelope and sent it out to anyone who signed up.
And I charged $11 for it. And I just posted it on TikTok. And the first month I got 50 people.
And it's normally just like a long letter about why I was inspired this month.
We normally can get about a thousand letters done in two and a half hours with how many people? With six people.

claims.quote: She's been running this business for 6 months and she's making about $30,000 a month in profit.

claims.quote: This month we have a golden ticket and it gives you and your pen pal a free year of the tiny post. Oh man, that's awesome. Yeah, you should you should test it with other things like a $100 Amazon gift card, like something not related and just see if that if that plays a role.

claims.claim: The host described recurring revenue as almost $50,000 monthly; Hannah agreed but did not state the figure herself.
claims.quote: Almost $50,000 a month recurring. Yeah.

claims.claim: The host guessed profit at $25,000 to $30,000 monthly, then Hannah said about $25,000.
claims.quote: And I'm just going to guess like half of that is profit. 25 30,000. Yeah. About Oh my goodness. 25,000.

claims.claim: The host later summarized the business as earning tens of thousands monthly profit in under six months.
claims.quote: I mean, in less than six months, you're making tens of thousands of dollars a month in profit doing something that you love.

acquisition_channels.details: Hannah posted the launch on TikTok, shared the origin story consistently, and later used Instagram and Pinterest; viral videos and customer unboxings also brought attention.
Some customers said a family member showed them the club or signed them up as a gift.

ideas.delivery: Hannah creates the monthly paper goods and letter, then she and helpers assemble the envelopes and mail them to subscribers.

prices: about $0.78 per stamp, as estimated by the host
about $3 hard cost per envelope, excluding labor
$100 Amazon gift card proposed as a test
